description: This file defines a PHP class named OperatorPrecedenceChange within the Twig namespace. The class models a change in operator precedence, including attributes for package name, version, and the new precedence value, along with appropriate getter methods.

classes.name: OperatorPrecedenceChange
classes.description: Represents a precedence change for an operator, with attributes for package, version, and new precedence.

methods.name: getPackage
methods.description: Returns the package name associated with the precedence change.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the package for which the precedence change applies.

methods.name: getNewPrecedence
methods.description: Returns the new precedence value for the operator.
